artworks.title: Venus of Cnidos, by Praxiteles
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body drawing of a nude figure standing upright with legs slightly crossed. The person is in a relaxed pose, with their right arm resting on an object draped with cloth, and the left hand hanging naturally. The figure has delicate facial features, a serene expression, and neatly styled hair close to the head. The figure is not wearing any clothing except for the draped fabric over the supporting object, which resembles a classical urn or column. The background is a simple gradient, darkening behind the figure to emphasize them as the focal point.

artworks.title: Discobulus, by Myron
artworks.artist: James William Giles after John Flaxman
artworks.description: The sculpture portrays a male athlete throwing a discus. The figure is depicted in a dynamic pose with one arm extended behind him holding the discus and the other arm bent in front of him. The figure is nude, showcasing detailed and muscular anatomy in an athletic stance. The material of the sculpture seems to be a light-colored stone or marble, seen through the smooth and polished texture. This classical representation captures a lifelike physique and pose, conveying motion frozen in time.

artworks.title: Statue on the Pediment over the West Front ofa Temple at Egina
artworks.description: The image is a full-body line drawing of a standing person. The person is depicted in an upright position with their head turned slightly to the side. The individual's facial features are sketched with small lips and a slightly pointed nose. Their hair is neatly arranged and encircles their head. They are dressed in a long, flowing garment with a distinct pattern, one sleeve featuring triangular designs, and a sash draped diagonally across the chest. The person holds a stick or staff in one hand. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Circle and Square of the Human Figure
artworks.description: The image shows two identical full-body illustrations of a person. One illustration depicts the person with arms outstretched horizontally, while the other shows them with arms and legs extended diagonally. The person is facing forward in both illustrations, with no detailed facial features or hair depicted. The person is nude, with light indications of muscles and body proportions. The top illustration features a rectangular grid around the figure, and the lower illustration is enclosed within a circle. The background is plain and minimalistic, resembling light-toned paper with subtle texture.

artworks.title: Extent of Motion, One Figure
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length outline drawing of a human figure standing upright, facing forward. The figure has a blank oval shape for a head and lacks detailed facial features and hair. The body is outlined with simple lines, without clothing. Around the figure are dashed lines and arcs originating from different points on the body, possibly representing motion or range of movement. The background is a plain, light-colored surface, with a faint, potentially handwritten note at the top that is not fully legible.

artworks.title: Extent of Motion Shown in Two Figures
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a study on the extent of motion in the human skeleton. Two outlined human figures in profile are surrounded by arcs and labeled points indicating possible range of motion for various limbs and body parts. The left figure shows circular arcs around the head and upper body, while the right figure focuses on the arms and legs. Lettered points correspond to notes below, explaining the type of movement each arc represents. The drawing is a diagram illustrating possible directions and limits of body movements, perhaps for anatomical or mechanical study.

artworks.title: Extent of Motion, Front and Side View Equipoised, Supported on One Leg
artworks.description: The image depicts four line-drawn representations of a human figure shown from different angles: side, front, side, and front. The figures display the full body from head to feet, with annotations indicating proportions. The facial features are not detailed, presenting only a basic outline of the head without individual features or hair. The figures are unclothed, with no visible accessories, set against a plain background with minimal text above and below them.

artworks.title: Preparing to Run; Running; Striking
artworks.description: The image shows outlined figures in athletic poses with dashed lines indicating movement or positions. Two figures at the top appear to be preparing to run and running. Below, a pair of figures show the progression of a striking action, with one figure appearing to thrust forward and the other showing an overhead gesture. The composition conveys elements of balance and motion.

artworks.title: Bearing a Weight; Preparing to Jump, and Alighting
artworks.description: The image displays simplified human figures demonstrating different forms of carrying and lifting weights. It includes four line drawings showing figures in various postures related to physical exertion: one holding a triangular object outstretched, another balancing a rectangular weight across the shoulder, a third in a crouched position as if preparing to lift, and the last leaning sharply backward with arms raised. Each figure is accompanied by a dashed line indicating balance, and there are handwritten notes under each illustration describing the action.

artworks.title: Leaning, Flying and Falling
artworks.description: This is a drawing of simple figures in various positions. The drawing consists of three outline figures engaging in different dynamic poses on a plain background. Each figure is labeled with a term describing their action or position. At the top, a figure is depicted horizontally with arms extended upwards. In the middle, a figure leans against a vertical surface. At the bottom, a figure is upside down with limbs in motion. All figures are rendered in a minimalist style with little detail beyond the basic outline.

artworks.title: Brazen Serpent, from Michael Angelo
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures surrounding a pole with a serpent wrapped around it. The image depicts various figures in different poses and states of distress, with many of them gesturing upwards or turning away. The figures are highly detailed and dynamic, creating a sense of movement and tension. Shading techniques highlight the muscular forms and expressions of the figures, lending depth and intensity to the scene.

artworks.title: Brazen Serpent, from Michael Angelo
artworks.description: The image shows human figures in various poses, with diverse facial expressions and hairstyles. The figures are layered and overlapping, with some in distress and others reacting to an external stimulus. Several characters are partially draped in clothing while others appear nude. In the center, a serpent is held aloft on a staff. The background is simple, emphasizing the figures and their interactions.

artworks.title: The Transfiguration
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures arranged with three standing and three sitting figures. The drawing is rendered in a grayscale palette, depicting a central figure in the top middle holding a book and gesturing with a raised hand, framed by two figures on each side, both appearing to read from books. Below them, three seated figures are depicted, each engaging in thought, one with a contemplative hand on the face. The figures are drawn with a flowing style that suggests draped clothing. The composition is balanced, showing a clear distinction between the standing and seated individuals.

artworks.title: Part of the Last Judgment from Michael Angelo
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of muscular, nude human figures intertwined in various poses. Their bodies are bent and twisted in a dynamic composition, with limbs interlocking. The figures show a high level of muscular definition, showcasing the artist's skill in depicting the human form. They occupy most of the space, creating movement and tension. Shading and lines contribute to a three-dimensional appearance, adding depth and contrast to the composition.

artworks.title: Holy Family, from Michelangelo
artworks.artist: Henry Noel Humphreys after John Flaxman
artworks.description: The image shows three figures portrayed from their lower bodies to heads. In the center is a seated woman facing away with her head turned slightly. She has a bun hairstyle and a serene expression. She wears a flowing gown. Behind her is an older man with a full beard looking contemplative and possibly guiding a child on the woman's shoulder. The child reaches forward and is depicted unclothed. The background is a blank expanse.

artworks.title: Last Judgment, Lincoln Cathedral
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing featuring a central seated figure surrounded by various other figures and elements in an ornate, symmetrical composition. The central figure holds a book and gestures with their hand. Other figures, some angelic, are arranged around the central figure, ascending and descending along arched paths, with some guided or judged by angels. The drawing has detailed line work that emphasizes form and expression, creating a celestial atmosphere reminiscent of religious iconography.

artworks.title: Figure from Peterborough Cathedral
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright in a frontal pose. The individual faces forward with a serene expression and a slightly tilted head. They have a veil covering their head and are wearing long, textured robes that fall to the ground. The person's right hand is raised in a gesture, while their left hand rests by their side. The background is a plain, shaded area that contrasts with the figure.

artworks.title: An Apostle, from Albert [sic] Durer
artworks.artist: James Henry Lynch after John Flaxman
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a side profile. The figure is upright, facing left, holding a cross with both hands, and a rolled parchment is tucked between the arm and chest. The person has a prominent nose, a thick white beard, and curly hair. They wear a flowing robe that reaches their bare feet. The person appears to be barefoot. The background is plain with light shading and shadows cast behind them.

artworks.title: Drapery
artworks.description: The image displays abstract lines and shapes that curve and flow with a sense of movement. The shapes resemble draped fabric or flowing water, with some lines cascading in a wave-like pattern. There are elongated curves that hang gracefully like curtains or the folds of a gown, giving a sense of lightness and fluidity. The arrangement of the lines suggests undulating motion, creating a connection to familiar objects such as flowing cloth or rolling waves.

artworks.title: Drapery, Three Figures, a Bacchante and Two From Nature
artworks.artist: Henry Noel Humphreys after John Flaxman
artworks.description: The image depicts three sketched figures. In the upper portion, a nude person is shown in a dynamic pose with one leg forward and arms stretched outward. The figure is bald and facing left, surrounded by swirling fabric. Below, there are two full-body figures. One figure is viewed from behind, draped in layers of fabric, with hair in a bun. The other figure faces left, wearing a long garment that follows the body's line, with hair in an updo. The background is a light surface with pencil marks and annotations, indicating it is a sketch.

artworks.title: Juno Lucina
artworks.description: The sculpture shows a standing figure covered in a long robe, with bare feet and a hand holding a scroll. The figure's head is turned slightly to the left, with a serene expression. The sculpture is monochromatic, likely made of stone. The portrayal of the human figure is life-sized and conveys formal dignity and grace.

artworks.title: Head of Our Savior, from Arringhi's "Roma Subterranea"
artworks.artist: Henry Noel Humphreys after John Flaxman
artworks.description: The image shows an individual with long, wavy hair, wearing a robe and holding a closed book or tablet. They have a serene expression and are surrounded by a circular halo.

artworks.title: Reverend John Upton
artworks.description: The image shows a man in profile facing right, showing the upper half of his body. He has European facial features, curly hair reaching his shoulders, and is dressed in a historical coat with a high collar and buttons. His left hand is partially visible. The background is plain, with a handwritten note and title at the bottom giving his name as Rev. John Upton and details about the sketch's creation and publication.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Gentleman
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on papier colle
artworks.description: The image is a portrait focusing on the upper half of a man's body, from the waist up. The man is positioned facing slightly to the viewer's right but looking straight ahead with his arms crossed. His facial features include strong eyebrows, a pointed nose, and a thoughtful expression. His hair is curly and styled away from his face. The man is dressed in a formal coat with a high-collared shirt underneath. No jewelry is visible, and there are no objects in his hands. The background of the portrait is a textured monochrome pattern which contrasts with the sepia tone of the surrounding area, and the image is framed within a larger blank matting that has a decorative border.
